title: Umbrella B — Multi-feature concurrency
body: Compose is invocation-scoped and serializes via active-build last-writer-wins. To safely run more than one feature at a time, three primitives need to land together: bounded concurrency control, isolated workspaces, and (optionally) a daemon to drive it autonomously. None of these are sound in isolation — daemon without bounded concurrency burns budget; concurrency without worktrees corrupts state. Treat as a single feature when scoped. **Depends on COMP-WORKSPACE-ID** for workspace identity.
